resources.string: Thank you for installing this app. If you liked my work you can donate. Any contribution removes ads.
Thank you for purchasing. All ads are removed.

This project is free, libre, privacy-focused and open-source.

- No trackers, analytics, or advertising libraries are included.
- No internet permission is requested by the app.
- Local data: logs and debug reports are stored locally; debug reports are sanitized (emails, phone numbers, tokens masked) before user shares them manually.
- When the built‑in diagnostics tool runs it creates two files: one with raw log data and one with personal information removed. You are asked to compare them before sending; only the sanitized file is attached to the email.

If you have concerns, open an issue at the repository and we'll address them.
Any donation will remove the ads.
Leave a positive rating on Google Play.
An Open Source, Light Weight equalization tool for all devices.
